information_and_model_claim.modeling_question: Can equal-weight training-only monotone marginal response calibration add portable nonlinear shape information while keeping every frozen factor direction and excluding interactions, fitted component weights and feature selection?
information_and_model_claim.historical_policy_permission: The walk-forward policy permits a new complete-library combination when the full library, transform, target, support, finite search catalog and all gates are frozen before model scores or returns.

nearest_consumed_families.reason: Campaign133 never fits cross-component weights: every one of 140 components has exact final weight 1/140 after an identical frozen marginal transform. Campaign102 fitted bounded linear weights and no marginal response shape.

nearest_consumed_families.family: deterministic complete-library percentile consensus and lower-quartile consensus
nearest_consumed_families.reason: Half of each contribution is the original favorable percentile to prevent hidden deletion, while the other half is a training-only monotone target calibration. The validation score must still pass all 140 component uniqueness gates before validation returns.

Campaign133 has no trees, leaves, boosting iterations, feature splits or interaction constraints. It fits 140 independent ten-bin monotone maps and averages them once. Campaign132 binaries and scores are not inputs and its parameters are not changed.

nearest_consumed_families.family: unanchored isotonic, spline GAM, subset, signed-weight and target-classification searches
nearest_consumed_families.reason: The selected catalog has one bin grid, one 50/50 anchor, one equal-weight aggregation, one target and one direction. Validation evidence cannot change any of them.

algebraic_and_counterfactual_checks: Increasing one finite favorable percentile while holding the fitted ten-bin maps and all other inputs fixed cannot decrease its anchored contribution or the final score.
Every component contributes an exact 0.5/140 identity slope outside bin boundaries, so PAVA flattening cannot silently remove a component.
Changing a training target can change only the ten fitted levels for that training fold; changing a validation return cannot change a precomputed validation score or its uniqueness record.
Permuting component order together with its fitted map leaves the arithmetic mean unchanged, but dropping, duplicating or reweighting any component violates the frozen 140-order binding.
Changing Candidate49, current daily data, a provider credential or the 2024-2025 lockbox cannot change any Campaign133 training or validation score.

admission.reason: This is a finite marginal nonlinear complete-library combination rather than a parameter refresh of Campaign102 or Campaign132.
